channel.description: Latest articles from The Meridian Star (meridianstar.com)

item.title: The MAX Announces upcoming art classes, youth Recording studio workshops, live music
item.description: Following a sold-out Evening of Jazz event last week, the Mississippi Arts + Entertainment Experience is excited to share details of upcoming events, including a conversation and book signing with author Jere Nash this Thursday, Jan. 29.

item.title: West Lauderdale fields talented roster to kick off 2026 baseball season
item.description: Over time, successful teams have learned one key lesson: winning usually comes with a history of repetition.

item.title: EMCC’s Diovion Famakinde collects MACCC Men’s Basketball Player of the Week honors
item.description: East Mississippi Community College’s Diovion Famakinde has earned MACCC Men’s Basketball Player of the Week honors for his pair of standout performances a week ago.

item.title: Law Enforcement Reports for Jan. 28
item.description: The Meridian Star provides a list of arrests and crimes being reported to authorities to keep the community informed about potential criminal activity. Names of individuals accused but not convicted […]

item.title: Hawks race past Raiders
item.description: Hartfield Academy is now one win away from a district title. Behind a fast start behind the three-point line the Hawks raced past Lamar School 59-37 on Tuesday night in a key MAIS District 2-4A matchup.

item.title: Civitan Club gives back to local groups with annual Night of Giving
item.description: Nonprofit organizations working to help those with disabilities or special needs have some additional resources to carry out their missions thanks to the Meridian First Ladies Civilian Club. The club recognized six local causes Tuesday at its annual Night of Giving.

item.title: Restoring Mississippi’s ballot initiative in 2026: Long road, real stakes, narrow chances
item.description: For the fifth straight year, lawmakers went back to the Capitol promising to “give the people their voice back.” That voice is the ballot initiative—Mississippi’s century-old experiment with direct democracy—and the 2026 session may be the best shot in years to restore it.

item.title: Bogeys and Stogies golf tournament to benefit Illuminations Center for Dyslexia
item.description: Golfers and non-golfers alike are invited to take a swing for a good cause as the Bogeys and Stogies Golf Tournament takes place Friday, March 20, at Lakeview Golf Course.

item.title: Extreme cold watch issued as freezing temps return
item.description: Lauderdale County residents will want to bundle up heading into the weekend as another round of bitter cold moves through the area. An extreme cold watch has been issued for much of the state from Friday night through 6 p.m. Saturday.

item.title: Great Southern Bank donates $86,000 to Hope Village
item.description: Great Southern Bank announced this week a donation of more than $86,000 to Hope Village for Children in partnership with the Mississippi Charitable Tax Credit Fund. The tax fund allows businesses to make contributions to qualifying organizations and receive a tax credit.
